construction: 7 canonical class/mechanism keys x 3 B1 Evidence families x 3 normalized pattern roles

pattern_roles.description: a normalized pattern with a plausible direct or contextual relationship to the class/mechanism
a common pattern that may occur in both target and non-target behavior
missing, weak, or contradictory support that cannot justify the class claim

entry_contract.evidence_pattern: normalized class/evidence-level pattern with no sample identity
entry_contract.question_to_reviewer: What class-level claim is semantically admissible from this pattern, and what stronger claim is forbidden?

future_response_contract.allowed_claim: bounded semantic claim supported by the pattern
future_response_contract.forbidden_claim: claim that the pattern cannot justify
